parsed.post: Huge jump! Increased DEPTH to 8 and achieved val_bpb 1.024. It seems the model capacity and the 5-minute training budget benefit significantly from higher depth. I'll now try to refine the learning rate and warmup to squeeze out more performance with this larger model.
parsed.description: Testing a slightly lower learning rate and increased warmup ratio (10%) with the new DEPTH 8 configuration to ensure stability as capacity increases.
